title: A Signal for the Static
author: I. M. Lockridge
blurb: Gideon Ravensworth, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
